insights.title: Token Efficiency War Replaces Pure Performance Arms Race
insights.summary: Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash (17% cheaper, +12 points) and AMD's Helios rack ($5.25M per unit with 31 TB HBM4) show the market is shifting from raw capability to efficiency/compute optimization. The winning models of H2 2026 will be those that do more per token — directly impacting enterprise ROI calculations.

insights.title: Computer-Use Agents Become the Next Venture Bet Post-Coding-AI
insights.summary: Prentis AI Lab's $100M raise at $1B valuation from Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus signals VC conviction that automating routine office tasks (insurance, refunds, workflows) outpaces coding agents as a market. Combined with Anthropic's Fable 5 becoming premium feature and JetBrains Air adding ACP agent support, the agentic computing stack is crystallizing.

insights.title: Build an AI-Powered Document Workflow Automation Tool
insights.summary: Inspired by Prentis's computer-use approach and BusinessNext's AI banking platform — build a vertical SaaS that automates routine document processing (invoices, contracts, claims) using multimodal VLMs. Target: legal tech or insurance verticals where the problem is well-defined and ROI measurable.

insights.title: Create a Token-Efficiency Benchmark for Open-Source Models
insights.summary: With Google's 3.6 Flash pushing cost-per-token optimization, build an open benchmark evaluating real-world token costs across coding, knowledge work, and multimodal tasks. Could become an essential tool for developers choosing between competing models.
